thread:
Jordan: Heads-up — ZenithBank wants an EU-only POC (BYO-KMS in their account). They want control-plane kept in EU if possible; otherwise a signed attestation that no telemetry leaves EU during the pilot. Need presales feasibility + 30-day pilot price. cc @Leah @Sam

Leah: Short clarifying q: are they OK with VPC peering or do they require guaranteed control-plane residency?

Jordan: RFP says preferred control-plane in EU; attestation acceptable for presales but legal may push Dedicated for contract. VPC peering preferred for auditor.

Sam (ops): Reality: Hosted control-plane runs in us-central. For a scoped POC we can do tenant pin to eu-west-1, disable telemetry/tracing, route audit logs to customer's S3 in eu-west-1, and optionally set up a temporary EU-resident proxy for management APIs. VPC peering avoids Cloudflare edges. Example minimal POC config:

```yaml
tenant: zenithbank-poc
region_pin: eu-west-1
byo_kms: true
telemetry: disabled
audit_log_sink: s3://zenithbank-poc-audit (eu-west-1)
control_plane_proxy: eu-temp-proxy
failure_mode: reject
```

Ivy (legal): We can sign a time-limited technical attestation describing the mitigations above. Must call out: attestation != contractual EU-control-plane. Dedicated/Private required for contractual guarantees.

Leah: Ops ask: can you confirm which subprocessors would still see metadata if we apply these mitigations? Auditor flagged any metadata to non-EU subprocessors as a deal-breaker.

Sam: With mitigations: payload stays in EU compute; telemetry/tracing & third-party analytics opt-out removes Datadog/Sentry; remaining risk is orchestration signals — mitigated by EU proxy for POC (no persistent US logs). I'll document subprocessors filtered for eu-west-1.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-12001 created: "ZenithBank EU POC - BYO-KMS + VPC peering + attestation" assigned to Sam.

Jordan: Cost ballpark for 30-day pilot? Small traffic (100 req/hr, ~150 tokens).

Sam: Ballpark: one-time setup ~$1.2k, pilot ops ~$700 for 30 days. Dedicated EU-control-plane pricing for prod starts ~ $11k/mo. I'll refine after sizing.

Leah: SE deliverable: 1-page runbook + config snippet + attestation draft. ETA EOD. Jordan: I'll loop customer once we have runbook and cost.

Jordan: Thanks — keep thread updates.
